Pushp Vanam vs Food Safety And Standards Authority Of ... on 
29 February, 2024 Author: Tushar Rao Gedela Bench: Tushar Rao Gedela  $~56  * IN THE HIGH COURT OF DELHI AT NEW DELHI  + W.P.(C) 3084/2024  PUSHP VANAM . 
 Through: Mr. Shanker Raju and   Gaur, Advocates. 
 versus  FOOD SAFETY AND STANDARDS AUTHORITY OF INDIA  . 
 Through: Mr. Rakesh Chaudhary   Tanvi, Advocates fo  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE TUSHAR RAO GEDELA  ORDER % 29.02.2024 (The proceeding has been conducted through Hybrid Mode) CM APPL. 12709/2024 (for exemption) 
1. Exemption is allowed, subject to all just exceptions. 
2. The application stands disposed of. 
W.P.(C) 3084/2024 & CM APPL. 12708/2024 (for stay) 
3. This is a writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, 1950, inter alia, seeking the following reliefs:-
"a) To call for the records and set aside the impugned order dated 22.11.2022 at Annexure P-1.
b) To direct the Respondent to revive the offer of appointment of the Petitioner on the post of Joint Director (Technical) and he be appointed on the post with all consequential benefits.
c) Any order or further relief which this Hon'ble Court deems fit, just and proper in the peculiar circumstance of the case in the interest of justice may also please be awarded."

1 4. Mr. Shanker Raju, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that vide the impugned order dated 22.11.2022, the offer of appointment dated 30.06.2022 was cancelled by the respondent on the This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above. The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 04/03/2024 at 22:06:56 basis that the petitioner had failed to join the respondent by an extended date of joining that was stipulated as 15.11.2022. 
5. Mr. Raju, learned counsel refers to the O.M. dated 06.06.1978 of the Department of Personnel and Training, placed at page No. 50 of the present petitioner, particularly sub-Clause (ii), to submit that the candidate, who wished to join and had sought an extension, the Department can extend the period of joining for nine months.
6. He further submits that in the present case, the respondent has violated the same, and as such,
the petitioner is entitled for revival of the appointment letter dated 30.06.2022.
7. Issue notice. 
8. Notice is accepted by Mr. Rakesh Chaudhary, learned counsel appearing for respondent. 
9. Upon the petitioner taking appropriate steps within a week, notice be served upon the respondents by all permissible modes. 
10. Counter affidavit be filed within six weeks with an advance copy to learned counsel for the petitioner. Rejoinder, thereto if any, be filed within six weeks, thereafter, with an advance copy to learned counsel for the respondent. 
11. List on 18.07.2024 before the Registrar for completion of service as also pleadings.
12. The appointments, which are being made, may be continued, however, shall be subject to the outcome of the present petition. 
TUSHAR RAO GEDELA, J FEBRUARY 29, 2024/nd This is a digitally signed order. 
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
